title: rewriteStatus comment says the page inks from the status line
body:
## Summary
The comment on rewriteStatus says the forensic page inks a rewrite while that text is the status. It does not.

## Description
desk/src/tv/keys.ts:136 says the page inks the move while the rewrite is the status. The first clause is true: rewriteStatus is the phone-chip line. The second is false. EssayTV inks from rewriteState being holds, and tools/essay-rules-test.cjs rewrite case 7 already forbids deriving ink from the status line. Fixed means the second clause matches that. The only edit is in tv-surface, outside this round's paths.

## Flow
- Read the comment on rewriteStatus.
- Read EssayTV's inked props and rewrite case 7.
- The page inks from the verdict state, not from the status string.

## Expected impact
A later edit that trusts the comment would ink from the status line and fail the existing test. The comment change itself is one line in keys.ts.

## Evaluation
Claim: quality - the comment matches the ink rule
Before: 1 of 2 clauses is false
After: 0 of 2 clauses false, comment only
Method: simulation - comment walked against rewrite case 7; no edit this round (out of scope, no --ab)
Result: better
Gate: none
evidence: desk/src/tv/keys.ts:136; tools/essay-rules-test.cjs rewrite case 7; desk/src/essay/EssayTV.tsx inks from rewriteState
